notes: During 1978, 60-0 percent of the total suicides were committed
by males and 40-0 percent by females, in the country as well as in the
States as @ whole. The $Male’ and ‘Female’ ratio in suicides for the
Union Territories as 4 whole was of 59-5 and 40-5 respectively,
while for the Metropolitan Cities, it was 56-0 percent and 44-0 per-
cent respectively. The percentage of male involvement in 11 States,
4 Union Territories and 4 Metropolitan Cities was higher than the
all-India average of 60 -0 percent. The details are presented in Table-VII.
